summary: Karooooo Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 2, 2026, announcing its annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for July 28, 2026. The notice is a routine corporate governance event under Singapore law, with a record date of June 15, 2026. No special-situation transaction or material corporate action is disclosed. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report for an ordinary AGM, not a special situation. No deal terms, advisor, or structural mechanics are present. This is a routine meeting notice, not an event-driven special situation.
